role: Prime Minister of the United Kingdom
promise: Cut annual net migration to 'tens of thousands' by the end of the parliament
description: Cameron pledged to reduce net migration to under 100,000 during the 2010-2015 parliament. Net migration instead rose to about 298,000 in 2014 and 336,000 in the year to June 2015 — his office later said the target was 'not achieved.'
evidence: Cameron's own government admitted the target was not met

review.note: Goal and failure supported. May 13 announcement date unestablished; policy predates election. 298,000 refers to year ending September 2014; later migration estimates were revised.
